sentences.en: "Do you mind my borrowing your microscope?" "No, not at all."
sentences.zh: 你介意我借用一下你的显微镜吗？“不，当然不。”

sentences.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
sentences.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的区别吗？

sentences.en: Germs can only be seen with the aid of a microscope.
sentences.zh: 只有在显微镜下才能看到细菌。
